name: How long does it take to install a bathroom in an ADU?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a bathroom in an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an ADU bathroom installation typically ranges from 3 to 6 weeks, but this can vary. Factors influencing the duration include the scope of work (e.g., full renovation vs. new construction), the availability of materials, and the efficiency of the permitting process. As a Process Clarity point, unexpected issues during demolition or framing, such as discovering outdated or damaged infrastructure, can extend the project timeline. Coordinating inspections from local authorities also plays a role in the overall duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU bathroom installation usually takes 3 to 6 weeks, depending on project scope, material availability, and permit processing. Unforeseen issues or inspection delays can extend the timeline.
